Findings written to `homework-4.4/run-retry2/workers/TASK-12.md`. Summary:

- `UpdateArticleParam` (title/body/description) has **no Bean Validation annotations**, unlike `NewArticleParam`'s `@NotBlank` on the same three fields (`NewArticleParam.java:17,21,24` vs `UpdateArticleParam.java:13-16`).
- This is intentional: `Article.update()` (`core/article/Article.java:51-65`) treats an empty string as "leave field unchanged" for partial PUT updates, so requiring non-blank values would break that semantic.
- But it's **undocumented** — no comment on the DTO, nothing in CLAUDE.md.
- Bigger latent issue: neither `ArticleApi.java:47` nor `ArticleCommandService.java:32` puts `@Valid` on the `UpdateArticleParam` parameter (unlike `createArticle`'s `@Valid NewArticleParam` at `ArticleCommandService.java:20`), so any constraint added to `UpdateArticleParam` in the future would silently never fire.
